translation.title: Rio by Night: Live Show and Churrascaria Dinner
translation.lead: Discover Brazilian music and dance at the Rio by Night show. Performers take the stage in colourful costumes, and dinner is served at a traditional Brazilian churrascaria.
included: Live music and traditional dance show.

hero.alt: Smiling performer in a costume with green and pink feathers
hero.hover: Performer in a carnival costume with green and pink feathers

translation.body: The show and dinner are available at an additional cost.
